# The /.well-known/ plain-fetch test, run by both sides:
#   cfm.lua well_known_plain (the in-path carve-out, Step 0a1) and
#   internal/webdetector isWellKnownChallengeExempt (the log-driven scoring
#   exemption). Columns: METHOD PATH QUERY EXPECT [RAW] (QUERY "-" = none;
#   EXPECT 1 = exempt). PATH is the decoded, normalised path the edge sees;
#   RAW, when given, the request target as sent (the edge compares the two,
#   the Go side reads RAW from the access log), else RAW = PATH.
